name: Ascalon
description: Ascalon's kit from Arknights for your Helldiver. Hidden until she makes noise: enemies see her far less and forget her, half the hits on her miss, her body and gear are not drawn. Ambusher: every hit of hers also strikes every enemy within 15 m. Mortal Interrogation: her hits mark enemies (3 stacks, 25 s) with damage every second and a slow. Pursuit (by itself, 3 charges): 210%, lands twice, slows. Endowment (X): 35 s of +130% damage, enemies around her slowed, kills spread marks. Descent (C): she steps out of hiding, no hit on her lands, +50% damage, each kill extends it. Parry: with a melee weapon in hand, a right-click just before a hit nulls it, puts her behind the attacker and counters. Dash: melee while moving dashes her forward through the enemies in the way. With a backpack on or a support weapon in hand she is not hidden. Solo or host. Settings in ascalon.ini. The look, the numbers and the status lines need Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. No character model included.
